description.en: Leafless axes with conspicuous spines and curled growing tips.
description.zh: 无叶枝轴带明显刺突及卷曲生长顶端。

scientific_scope.en: Conservative whole-organism reconstruction concept for Sawdonia ornata; cited fossils support gross structures, while unpreserved proportions and colour remain artistic choices.
scientific_scope.zh: Sawdonia ornata 的保守整株重建概念；所引化石支持主要结构，未保存比例和颜色仍属美术选择。

distinctness.en: Spiny continuous axes differ structurally from smooth Cooksonia and the segmented horsetail model.
distinctness.zh: 具刺连续枝轴在结构上区别于光滑Cooksonia及分节木贼模型。

modeling_brief.en: Use a few angular spine rows and hooked tips; preserve open spaces between branch tiers.
modeling_brief.zh: 用少量角状刺列与钩曲顶端建形，保留枝层之间的空隙。

uncertainty: Spine density and precise tip posture are simplified; roots are not invented.
reference_notes: Planning record only. Source access labels distinguish opened pages from indexed abstracts/excerpts. Reference-ready is not a released model or a completed dimensional/rights audit.
